title: PC방에서: 뭘 해야 컴퓨터를 쓸 수 있어요?
objective: Use -어야 to say what you must do first at a PC bang.
summary: A first-time PC bang customer signs up, adds time, and fixes a headset problem.
setting: The front counter and seats of a neighborhood PC bang, in the evening.

task.title: Use -어야 at the PC bang
task.line: Read each item, then write or choose the Korean that fits the situation at the PC bang.

words.meaning: signing up as a member (for an account at the shop)
words.exampleMeaning: To sign up, make a user ID first.

words.meaning: to add prepaid time or money
words.example: 시간이 거의 다 됐네. 조금 더 충전할까?
words.exampleMeaning: Our time's almost up. Should we add a bit more?

words.meaning: logging in (to the PC with your member ID)
words.exampleMeaning: I forgot my ID, so I couldn't log in.

words.example: 라면 하나 더 주문할게. 너도 뭐 먹을래?
words.exampleMeaning: I'll order one more ramyeon. Do you want something too?

words.meaning: to plug in, insert (a cable or USB)
words.exampleMeaning: Where do I plug in the USB?

words.meaning: the computer tower (the main box of a desktop PC)
words.exampleMeaning: The computer is making a strange noise.

dialogue.korean: 저기요, 처음 왔는데요. 그냥 자리에 앉으면 돼요?
dialogue.meaning: Excuse me, it's my first time here. Can I just sit down anywhere?

dialogue.korean: 먼저 회원 가입을 하셔야 컴퓨터를 쓰실 수 있어요. 저쪽 키오스크에서 하시면 돼요.
dialogue.meaning: You need to sign up as a member first before you can use a computer. You can do it at the kiosk over there.

dialogue.korean: 시간을 충전해야 로그인이 돼요. 현금은 여기 카운터에서 충전해 드려요.
dialogue.meaning: You can only log in after you add time. If you pay cash, I'll add it for you here at the counter.
Great. How do I order food?
Order on the screen at your seat, and we'll bring it to you.
Excuse me, I'm at seat 23. There's no sound in my headset.

dialogue.korean: 본체 앞쪽에 꽂으셔야 소리가 나와요. 그래도 안 되면 바꿔 드릴게요.
dialogue.meaning: You have to plug it into the front of the computer to get sound. If it still doesn't work, I'll swap it for you.

exercises: Fill in the blank with the -어야 form of 입력하다: 아이디와 비밀번호를 ____ 로그인할 수 있어요.
Join the two sentences into one with -어야: ① 선을 끝까지 꽂아요. 마우스가 움직여요. ② 시간을 충전해요. 게임을 시작할 수 있어요.
Fill in each blank with one word from the box (남은 시간 / 본체 / 회원 가입): ① ____이 5분이에요. 더 충전할까요? ② 컴퓨터가 안 켜지면 ____ 뒤에 선을 확인해 보세요. ③ 처음 오셨으면 ____부터 하세요.
Answer your friend in Korean using -어야. Your friend asks: "자리에서 바로 라면 시킬 수 있어?" Tell them you have to log in first to order: ____
answers: ① 선을 끝까지 꽂아야 마우스가 움직여요. ② 시간을 충전해야 게임을 시작할 수 있어요.
① 남은 시간 ② 본체 ③ 회원 가입
먼저 로그인해야 주문할 수 있어. (먼저 로그인을 해야 주문할 수 있어요 / 먼저 로그인해야 시킬 수 있어)
